heroSummary: Beaverton School District’s 2026–27 school year starts Tuesday, August 25, 2026, although BSD notes that first-day schedules may vary by grade level. The district calendar includes 174 student days and lists June 10, 2027, as the scheduled last day. June 14–18 are reserved as potential make-up days if needed. Pre-K follows a separate Monday–Thursday calendar beginning September 8.
calendarNotes: BSD schedules 174 student days in 2026–27, divided into quarters of 45, 42, 45, and 42 days, so the grading periods are not equal in length. The district calendar marks August 25 as the first day but says grade-level dates may be modified, so kindergarten and other families should use their school's opening instructions. Fall Break closes schools November 23–27, creating a full Monday-through-Friday break. Winter Break runs through January 1 and is followed by a January 4 staff-development day, so students return Tuesday, January 5. Pre-K uses a separate 135-day Monday-through-Thursday calendar, begins September 8, and does not hold classes on Fridays. Seniors finish June 3, all other students finish June 10, and staff have a grading day June 11, so those three end-of-year dates serve different groups. June 14–18 remain potential make-up days unless BSD needs them to recover instructional hours required by the Oregon Department of Education.

customSections.label: What the First and Last Dates Mean
customSections.content: BSD lists August 25 as the districtwide first day, but the calendar notes that start dates may vary by grade level. At the end of the year, seniors finish June 3, the scheduled last day for students is June 10, June 11 is a grading day, and June 14–18 are reserved for make-up days if needed.

customSections.label: Pre-K Has a Separate Four-Day Calendar
customSections.content: BSD uses a separate calendar for Pre-K and Preschool Promise. It has 135 student days, begins Tuesday, September 8, has no school on Fridays, and ends Thursday, June 10. Pre-K families should use the separate English or Spanish PDF because some staff and grading days on the district calendar do not apply to Pre-K.

customSections.label: Major Cultural and Religious Dates
customSections.content: These are not school-closure dates. BSD asks schools to avoid important events and tests on the listed observances; students observing a religious or cultural holiday may receive an excused absence and time to make up work.

whatsNew.title: 2026–27 Compared With 2025–26
content: School starts one day earlier in 2026–27: August 25 instead of August 26. Both calendars note that grade-level start dates may differ.
The scheduled last day also moves up one day, from June 11 to June 10; seniors finish June 3 instead of June 4.
BSD still schedules 174 student days, but the quarter breakdown changes from 45/41/42/46 to 45/42/45/42.
New for 2026–27 is a February 12 staff-development day; no February staff day appears on the 2025–26 district calendar.
Potential make-up days fall June 14–18, one day earlier than the June 15–19 window in 2025–26.

calendarFaqs.q: Do all Beaverton students start school on August 25?
calendarFaqs.a: Not necessarily. BSD lists August 25 as the districtwide first day, but the official calendar says first-day dates may be modified by grade level. Check your school's opening schedule.
No. They are potential make-up days and become attendance days only if BSD needs them to recover instructional hours after an emergency closure.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Beaverton Pre-K follow the district calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Not completely. The separate Pre-K and Preschool Promise calendar has 135 student days, begins September 8, has no school on Fridays, and ends June 10. Families should use the program PDF for Pre-K attendance dates.

calendarFaqs.q: Are BSD cultural and religious observances days off from school?
calendarFaqs.a: Not automatically. BSD asks schools to avoid important events and tests on these dates, but families should use the official closure dates to determine whether classes are canceled.

calendarFaqs.q: Will the downloaded calendar update automatically if BSD changes a date?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The .ics file is a one-time import, not a live subscription. Check BSD for later revisions and make-up-day announcements.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 9, 2026, against BSD's live calendar page, the official one-page English 2026–27 district calendar, the separate English Pre-K and Preschool Promise calendar, and the official cultural-observances guidance.
sourceReviewDetails: The district and Pre-K PDFs were rendered and checked visually because color and symbols distinguish school closures, no-student staff days, first and last days, semester endings, potential make-up days, and cultural observances.
The main district PDF contains 174 student days; the separate Pre-K PDF contains 135 student days and states that there is no school on Fridays.
Cultural and religious dates are kept separate from the school-closure list because BSD describes them as dates when schools should avoid important events and tests, not automatic no-school days.
The district PDF says first-day dates may be modified by grade level, so this page does not generalize one school's kindergarten or orientation schedule to the entire district.
The ICS file is a one-time import. Previously imported dates do not update automatically if BSD later changes the calendar or uses a make-up date.
